MemberList.description: The members of a collection that the caller may read, and the number of members left out because the caller may not read them.

hidden_count.description: The number of referrers or members the caller may not read, so are not listed.

member_iris.description: The IRIs of the members of a collection.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.

MemberList.title: MemberList

Referrer.description: One aggregate that points at another: its IRI, its schema class and the slot that holds the reference.

referrer.description: The IRI of the aggregate that holds the reference.

referrer_class.description: The name of the schema class of the aggregate that holds the reference; its IRI when the schema does not know the class.

referrer_slot.description: The name of the slot that holds the reference; its IRI when the schema does not know the slot.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.

Referrer.title: Referrer

ReferrerList.description: The aggregates that point at one resource and that the caller may read, and the number of referrers left out because the caller may not read them.

hidden_count.description: The number of referrers or members the caller may not read, so are not listed.

referrers.description: The aggregates that point at the resource, ordered by IRI and slot.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.
